detail: Full summary: The benchmark harness's twining conditions install with `npx -y twining-mcp` and NO version pin (src/conditions/twining-*.ts), and environment.twiningMcpVersion is EMPTY in all 15 recorded runs. The 892 pooled sessions spanning Feb-April are therefore version-uncontrolled — they tested whatever was npm latest that day, across a 1.x to 2.x transition. Historical results are directionally usable but are not a clean baseline for pre/post.
